end.summary:
Matched numerals to groups in 5 attempts; 3 were unaided correct.
Practised counting groups as objects disappeared and matching the remaining number.
Wrote and read numerals, including 6 and 9, with 2/2 unaided correct.
Used fingers to represent 8 as 5 and 3; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised matching numerals to groups by counting objects and recounting when one disappeared. Aarav explained that 8 can be shown as a full hand of 5 and 3 more fingers, and described how turning 6 around makes 9; this mix-up was corrected later in the lesson. At home, show small groups of objects and ask Aarav to count them, choose the numeral, and write it.
